title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeisle Woody…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Themeisle Woody ad snippets insert-php up to version 2.7.10. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in a victim's browser. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
